notes.title: Dungelot: Shattered Lands v1.33 update.
notes.notes:
- Added hotkeys : 
  
     1-4 to activate skills
    	C to craft
     	I to inventory
    	Esc to menu
   Space to skip dialog ( dialog also skip-able with mouse click )

- Fixed bug with sharp stones they now load properly after a loaded save.
- Fixed bug with flow blocking dungeon blocks
- Fixed exploit with infinite bomb crafting 
- Fixed bug with mansion oil not giving bombs the bonus
- Fixed bug with growing red cross
- Updated crossbow is a 1h weapon now
- Updated sharp stones can be used in packs instead by 1
- Updated blacksmith is activated by clicking mouse not spacebar
- Updated the main menu
- Update Vampire's Dark Hit  description 
- Updated Twitch Version
- item added - Dragonskin armor

notes.title: v1.32: Bug fixes & optimizations
notes.notes:
We're working super hard on updating Dungelot: Shattered Lands, here's the changelog for v1.32 (day 1 patch, woo!) 

- Fixed tons of bugs with coins
- Fixed tons of bugs with menus
- Fixed occasional crash in the hideout
- No more overlapping menus

Do let us know on the forum or in the comments if you're experiencing issues. We found out last-minute that on certain video cards the fonts don't render, so that was a fun fix. 

Happy dungeon crawling!

notes.title: First update adds tons of changes
notes.notes:
Hi all! The first iteration of the beta gave us tons of feedback. 

Here's the changelog

- added sfx/music controls
- you can now reassign your last used skill points
- mansion moved one level further
- added additional messages when you got into the first dungeon
- rebalanced prices
- highlighted what and and can't be bought in the mansion
- no more than 2 archers on levels now
- progress indicator per dungeon

- main thing is graves, places where you died previously now become their own spaces similar to taverns
- gives you a random perma-increase when you reach it

Please share feedback on the new experience
